fixtures.name: legacy-tls
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A negotiated legacy protocol proves configuration posture, not a historical exploit.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A failed handshake may be inconclusive when the client or provider disables TLS 1.0.

fixtures.name: legacy11-tls
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A negotiated legacy protocol proves configuration posture, not a historical exploit.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A failed handshake may be inconclusive when the client or provider disables TLS 1.1.

fixtures.name: weak-tls
fixtures.false_positive_notes: CBC support is a prerequisite signal and does not confirm Lucky13 exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Provider policy can suppress a CBC result even when another client would negotiate it.

fixtures.name: modern-tls
fixtures.false_positive_notes: TLS 1.3 support is a protocol posture observation only.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A TLS 1.3 failure may reflect client crypto-provider constraints.

fixtures.name: breach-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic HTTPS reflection with compression prerequisites
fixtures.negative: modern-tls HTTPS response without compression or sensitive reflection
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture intentionally combines compression, reflection, and cookie markers; the result is potential exposure, not demonstrated exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The heuristic reads the controlled GET responses only and cannot model application routing, browser behavior, or secret entropy.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-breach
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean modern fixture does not prove every application route is safe.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only GET / is tested and no real application secrets are accessed.

fixtures.name: legacy-tls-beast
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.0 CBC configuration detected by BEAST probe
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The result confirms the published TLS 1.0 CBC posture signal, not a browser exploit against an application.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Provider cipher policy and client crypto support can prevent the TLS 1.0 probe from completing.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-beast
fixtures.positive: No TLS 1.0 or SSL 3.0 CBC posture
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean endpoint does not prove every backend in a load-balanced fleet is clean.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the configured endpoint and resolved address are tested.

fixtures.name: sweet32-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello responses for the registered 3DES wire IDs
fixtures.negative: Any non-3DES cipher probe receives a TLS alert
fixtures.false_positive_notes: This fixture validates wire-level 3DES classification only; it does not implement a vulnerable TLS stack or demonstrate a birthday attack.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The synthetic responder does not model certificate exchange, protocol negotiation, or server implementation behavior.

fixtures.name: weak-ciphers-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello responses for registered RC4, NULL, RSA_EXPORT, and DH_EXPORT wire IDs
fixtures.negative: Any non-legacy cipher probe receives a TLS alert
fixtures.false_positive_notes: This fixture validates wire-level legacy cipher classification only; it does not implement a vulnerable TLS stack or demonstrate RC4, FREAK, or LOGJAM exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The synthetic responder does not model certificate exchange, protocol negotiation, DH parameters, or server implementation behavior.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-weak-ciphers
fixtures.positive: No registered legacy cipher IDs accepted by the modern TLS fixture
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean modern fixture does not prove every backend in a load-balanced fleet is clean.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the configured endpoint and resolved address are tested.
